programs.name: Computer Science
programs.description: Modern CS program in Brno with specializations in AI, cybersecurity, and web technologies. Faculty of Informatics is internationally recognized. Strong ties to Brno tech hub.

programs.name: Data Science

programs.name: Economics
programs.description: International economics, finance, and economic analysis. Brno location offers proximity to Austrian and German business centers.

programs.name: International Relations and European Politics
